title: Identity Document Does Not Match Client
detail: The verification record marks the certified passport as accepted for client Joe Bloggs, but the attached image shows a passport in the name of Benedict Summers. This is a fundamental customer due diligence failure and does not satisfy lender identity expectations when acting for a lender.
reference: Acting for Lenders and Prevention and Detection of Mortgage Fraud, Checking Identity by Original Documents
codeAreaLabel: Acting for Lenders and Prevention and Detection of Mortgage Fraud
